mapper.sql: FROM sys_session s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.revoke_time IS NULL AND s.expire_time > #{now}
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, u.username, s.device_info, s.ip_address, s.create_time, s.expire_time, CASE WHEN s.id = #{currentSessionId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_current
AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_session s JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = s.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND r.role_code = 'super_admin' AND r.status = 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_session SET revoke_time = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoke_time IS NULL
UPDATE sys_session SET revoke_time = #{now} WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{hash} AND revoke_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, s.expire_time AS expireTime, s.revoke_time AS revokeTime, u.status FROM sys_session s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.refresh_token_hash = #{hash} FOR UPDATE
